_note: Plain words for every name a code block can use. The names strip reads this. Form controls: what it is in MY example. Global.*: what the notebook line holds.
Global: the file that remembers things for the whole program
pnlLogin: the panel that holds the login boxes and button
tbxUsername: the box where the username is typed
tbxPassword: the box where the password is typed
lblUsername: the label beside the username box
lblPassword: the label beside the password box
lblTitle: the title at the top of the login form
lblSubtitle: the small line under the title
pbxLogo1: a picture box with a logo
pbxLogo2: a picture box with a logo
btnHelp1: the ? button on the login form
pnlPupilDetails: the panel that holds the pupil's name, gender and year group
pnlSwimLengths: the panel that holds the three attempts and the average
pnlQuizResult: the panel that shows the quiz score and the Take Quiz button
pnlReactionTest: the panel that shows the test score and the Take Test button
pnlSwimmingGroup: the panel that works out the group
tbxSurname: the box where the surname is typed
tbxFirstName: the box where the first name is typed
cbxYeargroup: the drop-down list for year group
btnEnter: the Enter button under the pupil details
tbxCalculateAverage: the box that shows the average
lblQuizStatus: the label that says whether the quiz has been taken
lblTestStatus: the label that says whether the test has been taken
btnCalculateSwimmingGroup: the button that works out the group
tbxSwimmingGroup: the box that shows the group
lblPupilDetails: the heading of the pupil details panel
lblSwimLengths: the heading of the attempts panel
lblQuizResult: the heading of the quiz panel
lblReactionTest: the heading of the test panel
lblSwimmingGroup: the heading of the group panel
lblSurname: the label beside the surname box
lblFirstName: the label beside the first name box
lblGender: the label beside the gender list
lblYeargroup: the label beside the year group list
lblTitle2: the title at the top of the data entry form
pbxLogo3: a picture box with a logo
btnHelpPupilDetails: the ? button in the pupil details panel
btnHelpSwimLengths: the ? button in the attempts panel
btnHelpQuizResult: the ? button in the quiz panel
btnHelpReactionTest: the ? button in the test panel
btnHelpSwimmingGroup: the ? button in the group panel
pnlQuizScore: the tall panel on the left that shows the score and the Return button
pnlTextQuestion: the panel for question 1, which is answered in a text box
gbQuestion4: question 4's group box of radio buttons
rbA: the first radio button of question 4
rbB: the second radio button of question 4
rbC: the third radio button of question 4
rbD: the fourth radio button of question 4
tbxQuestion1: the text box where question 1 is answered
cbxQuestion3: the drop-down list where question 3 is answered
pbxQuestion3: the picture that question 3 asks about
btnCorrect: the button of question 2 that is the right answer
btnIncorrect: the button of question 2 that is the wrong answer
lblResult: the label that shows the score as a number
lblComment: the small line of words under the title
btnHelpQuizScore: the ? button in the score panel
pbx1: picture box 1 of the 12 on the test form
pbx12: picture box 12 of the 12 on the test form
pbxRed: the key picture that shows what a red picture means
pbxWhiteandBlack: the key picture that shows what a white and black picture means
pbxYellowandRed: the key picture that shows what a yellow and red picture means
pnlReactionTestStats: the panel that holds the name, the time, the score and the Start button
btnStart: the Start button of the test
lblTime: the label that counts down the seconds
lblName: the label that shows the pupil's name
lblSafeToSwimSprint: the title of the test form
tmrSwap: the timer that swaps the pictures
tmrCountdown: the timer that counts the seconds down
CountdownValue: the number of seconds left, kept at the top of the test's code
pictureboxes: the list that holds the 12 picture boxes
dgvReport: the grid that shows the table
cbxGroup: the drop-down list that filters by group
cbxYear: the drop-down list that filters by year group
btnClose: the close button on the report
lblGroup: the label beside the group list
lblYear: the label beside the year list
lblReportInstructions: the line of instructions at the top of the report
dt: the table held in memory, kept at the top of the report's code
Global.quizScore: the quiz score, a whole number
Global.firstname: the first name that was entered
Global.yearGroup: the year group that was chosen
Global.quizTaken: true once the quiz has been taken
Global.averageCalculated: true once the average has been worked out
Global.average: the average of the three attempts, a decimal
Global.reactionTestScore: the test score, a whole number
Global.reactionTestTaken: true once the test has been taken
Global.assignedGroup: the group that was worked out
double: A number that can have a point, like 4.5.
errors: the list of problems found so far
passValidation: true while every box looks right. Any failed check makes it false.
average: the three attempts added up and divided by 3
roundedAv: the average cut down to 2 numbers after the point
clickedPicturebox: the picture box that was clicked
pb: each picture box in the list, in turn
PictureBox_Click: the code that runs when a box is clicked
